categories.main_business_segments: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. operates four main business segments: (1) Airport Real Estate (leasing office buildings, hangars, and factory buildings within airports), (2) Non-Airport Real Estate (leasing and sales of office buildings, residential complexes, and hotels outside airports), (3) Airport Infrastructure (district heating/cooling, water supply/sewage, and shared communications within airports), and (4) Other Businesses (overseas real estate leasing, lending, equipment leasing, and solar power generation).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core capabilities center on the development, leasing, and management of specialized airport facilities and infrastructure, including advanced district heating/cooling systems, water supply and sewage management, and the construction and maintenance of hangars and technical centers. It utilizes both asset-heavy (ownership and management of real estate) and asset-light (value-add and resale of properties) approaches, with a focus on energy efficiency, environmental compliance, and facility resilience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are airlines (notably Japan Airlines and All Nippon Airways), airport operators, and aviation-related companies, with a significant portion of revenue derived from these sectors. The company also serves logistics, hospitality, and commercial tenants in both airport and non-airport locations, as well as overseas clients through its international subsidiaries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, particularly at major airports such as Haneda (Tokyo), Kansai, Chitose, and others, with additional real estate holdings in urban centers like Tokyo and Osaka. The company also has overseas operations in Singapore and Canada, primarily through wholly owned subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. operates primarily downstream in the supply chain, providing end-user services such as facility leasing, infrastructure management, and utility provision directly to airlines, airport operators, and tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening its core airport-related businesses, expanding non-airport and overseas real estate operations, and enhancing capital efficiency. Key themes include sustainability (CO2 reduction, renewable energy adoption), disaster resilience, and human capital development. There is no significant proprietary R&D, but the company invests in facility upgrades, energy efficiency, and digitalization of operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through long-term leasing of real estate and infrastructure within and outside airports, utility service fees (heating/cooling, water), property sales (in the non-asset segment), and, to a lesser extent, overseas real estate leasing, lending, and solar power generation. The business model is largely based on recurring rental and service income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other airport facility operators, real estate companies with airport or logistics specialization, and infrastructure service providers. The company holds a unique position as a leading independent provider of airport-related real estate and infrastructure in Japan, with strong relationships with major airlines and airport authorities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥31.1 billion (approx. $200 million), with operating profit of ¥4.47 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥2.58 billion. The company has demonstrated strong post-pandemic recovery and growth, with revenue up 19.9% and net profit up 27.6% year-on-year, and maintains a solid balance sheet with a 55.1% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. differentiates itself through its deep expertise in airport-specific real estate and infrastructure, long-term relationships with major airlines, and ability to provide integrated facility and utility services tailored to the aviation sector. The company emphasizes reliability, safety, environmental sustainability, and the ability to support both aviation and urban development needs.
